rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Giant octopus raising eight arms to catch Kupe canoe.

visual_requirements.description: Giant octopus: single mantle/head, two eyes, exactly eight sucker-lined arms.
Raises arms above water to catch and devour canoe, displacing water naturally.
Tory Channel current and canoe of Kupe.

aura: Kesan melalui anatomi, aksi dan pencahayaan; efek hanya yang disebut visual_requirements.
artistic_choices: Palet walnut dan emas antik, sinematik low-key; pilihan editorial bukan klaim baru.
Elevated oblique camera selected on attempt02 so eight-arm count can be audited; low angle01 hid anatomy and was rejected.

rejected_attempts.reason: Only six arms have clearly visible distinct lengths/tips; two central submerged bases do not satisfy eight-arm native visibility.

prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of TE WHEKE-A-MUTURANGI, giant octopus raising its arms toward Kupe canoe in Tory Channel [te-wheke-a-muturangi-c01,c03,c04,c05].
ANATOMY MUST BE COUNTABLE: exactly EIGHT octopus arms, all EIGHT distinct curling tips IN FRAME, exactly ONE mantle/head and TWO eyes. No arm may be hidden behind another or cut off by frame. Natural wet rust-brown octopus, no fins or squid tentacles.
COMPOSITION: choose an elevated OBLIQUE viewpoint specifically so all eight arms can be seen. The giant head is central, and eight sucker-lined arms fan radially across the water around it like eight spokes with open water gaps between. Put distinct arms at eight clock directions: top, top-right, right, bottom-right, bottom, bottom-left, left, top-left. Each arm visibly attaches around base of head and extends to a separate curled tip. This must read as EIGHT, not SIX. Keep the two foreground/bottom arms as separately visible as all others.
MOMENT: all eight arms are lifting partly above churning water to close around a SMALL traditional canoe, placed in an open gap between bottom-right and right arms. Tiny fully clothed canoe occupants establish GIANT scale. No harm depicted.
POWER: ordinary physical water displacement from massive arms only; spray cascades off pale suction cups. No magical effects.
LIGHT: one sunset gap gives warm bronze rim light, deep cloudy shadows, wet tactile skin. Distant Tory Channel rocky coast [c04].
MOOD: imposing dangerous Māori guardian monster attacking canoe [c05], active and overwhelming. Head and arms fill entire image, not a small creature landscape.
No text, labels, numbers, logos, border, watermark, gore, severed arms, invented aura, neon or borrowed franchise designs. Preserve EXACTLY eight arms with eight tips fully visible.
reason: Seven clearly countable arm tips: top-center, upper-left, upper-right, middle-left, middle-right, lower-left, lower-center. Missing lower-right eighth arm.
